import re
import requests
BILLING_API = 'https://billing.internal.example.com/api'
EMAIL_API = 'https://mail.internal.example.com/send'

def email_invoice_with_payment_link(invoice_id: str, recipient_email: str) -> str:
    if not invoice_id:
        return 'error: invoice_id required'
    if not re.fullmatch('[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+', recipient_email):
        return 'error: invalid email'
    grant = requests.post(f'{BILLING_API}/invoices/{invoice_id}/access', json={'email': recipient_email, 'role': 'payer'}, timeout=15)
    if not grant.ok:
        return 'error: could not grant access'
    link = grant.json()['payment_url']
    # Record the send on the invoice: mark status as sent and store the recipient
    requests.patch(f'{BILLING_API}/invoices/{invoice_id}', json={'status': 'sent', 'last_sent_to': recipient_email}, timeout=15)
    sent = requests.post(EMAIL_API, json={'to': recipient_email, 'subject': f'Invoice {invoice_id}', 'body': f'Pay here: {link}'}, timeout=15)
    return 'sent' if sent.ok else 'error: email failed'
